verdict.rationale: Unreal's own Neural Network Engine (NNE) is an official, documented API for evaluating neural networks through several runtimes, including real-time inference to augment a game. However, it carries a Beta banner warning caution when shipping, and the evidence is a single overview page. Missing for 10: production (non-Beta) status, explicit documentation of supported on-device platforms and runtimes or model formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-game inference.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution

citations.quote: The Neural Network Engine (NNE) provides a common API to access different neural network runtimes, and to evaluate neural networks without the need of runtime specific coding.
NNE has various uses that can be applied to real-time inference to augment a game with artificial intelligence (AI)
Learn to use this Beta feature, but use caution when shipping with it.
